name: Mario is on block half
description: True if the point where Mario touches the block lies in the chosen half of it, 8 pixels each ($9A for horizontal, $98 for vertical; the game does not round them to the block). In Top that is his foot, in Left and Right his side. Mario has two foot points, 6 pixels apart: while he stands across the middle, both halves are true in the same frame, one for each foot.
author: BlockCreator
